# CYRANTA

> CYRANTA is a data intelligence company that curates, builds and licenses exclusive industry datasets, implements data pipelines and sets up data clean rooms on AWS for AI training teams, researchers and industry analysts.

Tagline: Data that can build anything.

## Start here

- Industry Opportunity Snapshot (free): a sample dataset, a model demo or a data refresh run, plus a data card, so buyers can test the data before they buy.

## Services

- Exclusive datasets: curated industry datasets, each licensed to a single buyer.
- Data curation: deduplication, normalization, labeling, personal data removal and batch documentation.
- Algorithms and pipelines: collection, transformation, classification and scheduled refreshes, with a log of every run.
- Data clean rooms on AWS: two or more parties analyze data together while each side's raw data stays private; only agreed outputs come out.

## Formats

Parquet, JSONL or CSV, or the format the buyer's pipeline already uses.

## Confidentiality

CYRANTA signs an NDA before reviewing any client data. Client data never appears on the website.
